description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by disc-0016. The single discovery file is a conformant RFC 9264 link set: linkset is the sole top-level member, integrity rides on the links as RFC 9530 digest and agsc-* extension target attributes whose values are arrays, bundle facts live only on the anchor's describedby link, and relation names are either IANA-registered short names or .../rel#<name> extension URIs. Supersedes disc-0001, which pinned the pre-D55 two-member shape.
note: path updated 2026-09-04 (D60) from /.well-known/agentic-knowledge to /.well-known/knowledge-linkset; this vector was added today at rc.2 and is unreleased, so editing in place is allowed (never done to disc-0001/0002, which are withdrawn and frozen).
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.6 (RC6-C; item ENG8-01 of the specification-items list, raised by ENG-8). This vector states the bundle-fact attributes of the anchor's `describedby` link as exactly five. AGSC-06-08 as amended at rc.6 under owner decision D113 names SIX — `agsc-bundle-version`, the content version of AGSC-04-25, is a bundle fact and rides on that link with the rest — and AGSC-06-08a makes every `agsc-*` attribute on that link REQUIRED at Level 2 and above. The document this vector pins is therefore no longer a conforming Level-2 document, and a conforming engine cannot pass it as written. Superseded by disc-0016, which states the six attributes and everything else this vector asserts: the sole top-level member, the media type, the path, the profile, the ledger-link attributes, the array-valued target attributes and the two relation lists.
